# WO-222: Guard the human-readable todo list output
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-056)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.x / v0.4 (after v0.3.0)
Agent: Nora Bennett's channel session (Nora assigns the builder). One WO = one session.
Source: CP-40 (pm #168) (docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md), accepted as proposed

## Goal / acceptance criteria
As in CP-40: assert `freemyid todo list` rows (`[first-eight-id-chars] profile label · kind · title`), truncation, labels and empty-list output. JSON privacy is already covered; no copy/body text may appear in the rows either.
Fake data only. Stub or monkeypatch everything that would touch the network, the store, the keyring or the user's files. A real product bug: strict `xfail` with the reason plus a finding with file:line in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_todo_list_text.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_cli_todo_list_text.py`
- `../../.venv/bin/ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_cli_todo_list_text.py`
